design_notes: The traveller prefers the nonstop, but the Miami connection costs CHF 690 against CHF 1,480: it saves CHF 790, 53% of the nonstop fare, a significant financial gain on any reading of lines 230-231, so the alternative route and the best possible fare (line 233; line 581, the most economical fare).
